recall.note: No recall found for the Thule Urban Glide line; the 2020 Thule stroller recall was limited to the Thule Sleek (handlebar detachment).

safety.notes: 5-point magnetic safety harness; twist hand brake for controlled descents; wrist safety strap; auto-lock fold.

specs.recline: multi-position recline to near-flat, one-hand toggle
specs.tires: pneumatic air-filled rubber; front 12 in swivel/lockable, rear 16 in

notes: Current-generation 3-wheel jogger (~26.2 lb). IMPORTANT (Clek caveat carried from _CLEK_LIST.md): the UG3 is 'Not compatible in double mode' with the Liing — single-seat car-seat use only. Clek Liing attaches via the Urban Glide UNIVERSAL adapter 20110762 (adapter-20110762), NOT the Maxi-Cosi-specific 20110761. Best cited price $799.95 (REI / Thule DTC). A jogger, not the light/compact city goal.
